blocks.orig: If you want to get away from the daily grind of life and want to go on a vacation that takes your mind off it, we hear you. There are plenty of ways you can make your safari escape something exciting and meaningful to you.
blocks.html: Need a break from the daily routine, a holiday that takes your mind off everything? We understand. There are many ways to turn your safari escape into something exciting and meaningful for you.

blocks.orig: So, when you return, you feel revitalized and full of stories that you can share, as if you go on a Tanzanian safari, you won’t want to stop talking about your experience there.
blocks.html: The idea is that you come home feeling refreshed and full of stories to share. Once you have been on a Tanzanian safari, you will find it hard to stop talking about it.

blocks.orig: But what lodges are going to ensure that you get the best views? And, more importantly, which allow you to partake in the best activities that are great for a group or the family?
blocks.html: But which lodges will give you the finest views? And, more to the point, which ones offer activities that work well for a group or for the whole family?

blocks.orig: In this article, we outline the ten best safari lodges in the region that allow you to see the plains in different ways and see and come face to face with some magnificent animals.
blocks.html: Below we run through the ten finest safari lodges in the region, places that let you experience the plains from different angles and bring you face to face with some magnificent animals.

blocks.orig: Read on to find out how you can have the best escape imaginable.
blocks.html: Read on to find out how to make your escape as good as it can be.

blocks.orig: Here is an area that is a 40-minute drive from the Seronera airstrip. On the way to this exclusive lodge, you’ll see why this destination is adored and visited by many nature and wildlife enthusiasts – so you’ll be in good company here.
blocks.html: This spot lies a 40-minute drive from the Seronera airstrip. On the road to this exclusive lodge, it quickly becomes clear why so many nature and wildlife enthusiasts love and return to this destination; you will be in good company.

blocks.orig: You have an arrangement of nicely placed tents that give you striking views while being slap-bang in the middle of the Serengeti National Park, so brace yourself for some unique encounters with the likes of zebras and hyenas close by.
blocks.html: The tents are thoughtfully arranged to give you striking views, right in the heart of Serengeti National Park, so be prepared for unique encounters with animals such as zebras and hyenas close to camp.

blocks.orig: You can also find some special sunset views, which are a nice way to settle down with á la carte meals. How about a homemade pizza with a side of grilled veggies? No matter what you go for, ingredients are delivered fresh every day. Nice plus: you can get tea and coffee refreshments all day.
blocks.html: There are special sunset views too, a lovely backdrop for the à la carte meals. Fancy a homemade pizza with grilled vegetables on the side? Whatever you choose, the ingredients arrive fresh every day. A welcome extra: tea and coffee are available throughout the day.

blocks.orig: Situated near the northeast of the Serengeti and close to the Ikorongo game reserve, you have here a lodge that takes the immersion with nature to a whole new level. So you can take it easy knowing that you have a lot of modern living features with an authentic experience.
blocks.html: Set towards the northeast of the Serengeti, close to the Ikorongo game reserve, this lodge takes immersion in nature to another level. You can relax knowing that modern comforts and an authentic experience go hand in hand here.

blocks.orig: This peaceful camp welcomes you with cosy tents and nearby dining areas. Prepare to fall in love with the furnishings, which, by the way, have a minimal impact on the environment.
blocks.html: The tranquil camp greets you with snug tents and dining areas close by. You are likely to fall for the interiors, which, incidentally, were chosen to keep the footprint on the surroundings as small as possible.

blocks.orig: With national parks, a hippo pool, and balloon tours on offer, you have more ways to see elephants, cheetahs, lions, and so much more, at your own pace.
blocks.html: With parks to explore, a hippo pool and balloon flights on the menu, you have even more ways to watch elephants, cheetahs, lions and much more, at a pace that suits you.

blocks.orig: If you’re a big cat enthusiast, it’s hard to ignore the view of them you can find here. Why? This lodge is tucked into the corner of the Serengeti and with personal game guides that can show you the best picture-taking opportunities, there is plenty to appreciate.
blocks.html: If big cats are your passion, the sightings here are hard to beat. Why? The lodge sits tucked into a corner of the Serengeti, and personal game guides can point you to the best photo opportunities, so there is a great deal to enjoy.

blocks.orig: You can also go on walking safaris, where you can navigate the trail, which can be identified by the various animals you’ll see, such as gazelles, antelopes, and buffalo. This way you can get really close to them and feel in the moment – exhilarating, to say the least.
blocks.html: Walking safaris are also on offer, following a trail marked out by the animals you meet along the way, such as gazelles, antelopes and buffalo. It lets you get genuinely close and feel fully present in the moment, which is exhilarating, to put it mildly.

blocks.orig: It’s the people here, though, that make this stay worth it, as the boma gathering before dinner gives you a chance to get to know other visitors and staff as you compare your experiences of that day.
blocks.html: What really makes a stay here worthwhile, though, is the people. The boma gathering before dinner is a chance to get to know other guests and the staff while you swap stories about the day.

blocks.orig: From first impressions, we are loving the villa-type design of this lodge. It’s located right on top of the rift valley escarpment, where you’ll catch a stunning view of the Lake Manyara and a glance at Kilimanjaro that towers in scale at a further distance.
blocks.html: On first impressions, we really like the villa-style design of this lodge. It sits right on the edge of the rift valley escarpment, giving you a stunning view over Lake Manyara and a glimpse of Kilimanjaro rising up far in the distance.

blocks.orig: You have your pick from silver, golden, and platinum rooms that are designed with the local culture in mind, with a lot of organic-looking and hand-made features that will have you in awe.
blocks.html: Silver, golden and platinum rooms are available, each shaped by the local culture and full of organic, hand-crafted details that will leave you impressed.

blocks.orig: You have the lake Manyara treetop walkway and Tanzania zipline adventure center for those who want to go off the beaten track and start their own adventures, so there’s plenty to get involved with.
blocks.html: Keen to leave the usual routes behind and start your own adventure? The treetop walkway at Lake Manyara and the Tanzania zipline adventure centre are both on hand, so there is plenty to get stuck into.

blocks.orig: Adventure awaits at this camp, as you will be situated in the Ruaha National Park, which has plains and national parks for as far as the eye can see. Here, you’ll feel as if you’ve genuinely escaped with just you, the wilderness, mighty baobabs and shrubs.
blocks.html: Adventure is waiting at this camp inside Ruaha National Park, where plains and parkland stretch as far as you can see. Here it genuinely feels as if you have got away from it all: just you, the wilderness, mighty baobabs and shrubs.

blocks.orig: Whether you’re relaxing in the camp or out for a tour, you’ll be able to catch a glimpse of a lion, elephant, buffalo, and endangered African wild dogs, which makes for insightful viewing.
blocks.html: Whether you are relaxing in camp or out on a tour, you may well catch sight of a lion, elephant, buffalo or the endangered African wild dog, which makes for fascinating viewing.

blocks.orig: You get an en-suite bathroom, swimming pool, spa, and even Wi-Fi, but we’ll doubt you’ll want to be on your devices for too long when you see the variety of activities that are on offer.
blocks.html: An en-suite bathroom, a swimming pool, a spa and even Wi-Fi are all included, though once you see what there is to do here we doubt your devices will get much attention.

blocks.orig: We move now to the north of the Serengeti National Park. And if seeing the wildebeest crash across the Mara river as part of the annual migration is something on your bucket list, this camp is the perfect place to see it unfold.
blocks.html: Next we head to the northern part of the Serengeti. If watching the wildebeest plunge across the Mara river during their yearly trek is on your bucket list, this camp puts you in the perfect spot to see it happen.

blocks.orig: You’ll notice the tents at the camp have a cabin-like aesthetic to them. So make yourself at home with the amenities you’ve come to expect – you can even request a friendly early morning wake-up call with tea and coffee delivered to you.
blocks.html: The tents here have a cabin-like feel. Settle in with all the amenities you would expect; you can even ask for a friendly early morning wake-up call, with tea and coffee brought to your tent.

blocks.orig: There is also the opportunity for you to unwind after your game drive at the pool or local spa, and why not take a look at the safari shop, as you can be sure to find something nice?
blocks.html: After your game drive you can unwind at the pool or the on-site spa, and the safari shop is worth a browse too, as there is bound to be something nice to take home.

blocks.orig: Here is a camp that is situated at the Ngorongoro crater and gives you a private yet highly placed on the slopes of the Olmoti crater, which is the highest view you can experience in the area. So if you love a good view, you’ll not want to skip past this one.
blocks.html: This camp is set at the Ngorongoro crater and offers a private position high on the slopes of the Olmoti crater, which is the highest viewpoint you can experience in the area. If a good view matters to you, this is not one to miss.

blocks.orig: The suites are perspex and canvas domed, giving you an all-around view at all times, giving you the immersion that you didn’t know was possible.
blocks.html: The suites are domes of perspex and canvas, so you have a view in every direction at every hour, a level of immersion you may not have thought possible.

blocks.orig: You can expect activities that range from solo travels, safaris, natural wonders, or maybe a trip to see the local Maasai cultured communities.
blocks.html: Activities range from solo outings and safaris to natural wonders, or perhaps a visit to the local Maasai communities and their culture.

blocks.orig: Here is an option for those who want to go fully native: the luxury tree-house suites blend in well with the surrounding forest. The sounds and sights of wildlife will surely compliment your stay and give you exclusivity and a sense of rejuvenation.
blocks.html: For those who want to go fully native, the luxury tree-house suites merge seamlessly into the forest around them. The calls and movements of the animals nearby will surely enrich your stay, offering both privacy and a genuine sense of renewal.

blocks.orig: You will get some unique views of a range of habitats and can catch glimpses of tree-climbing lions and families of elephants, with a chance to see some bright flamingoes near the shores of the nearby lake.
blocks.html: You will enjoy unusual views across a range of habitats, with chances to spot tree-climbing lions and elephant families, and perhaps some bright flamingoes along the shore of the nearby lake.

blocks.orig: You get a unique safari experience as you’ll have access to fact sheets and binoculars for the best way to learn and see these magnificent animals in both the morning and evening.
blocks.html: What makes the safari here special is that you are handed fact sheets and binoculars, the best way to learn about and watch these magnificent creatures at dawn and at dusk alike.

blocks.orig: Here is an Edwardian-styled manor house that allows you a sophisticated and luxurious experience, with grand entrances and wraparound verandas that offer a good view of the vast landscape and neighboring areas like the Motukeri and Nyakitono villages.
blocks.html: This Edwardian-style manor house offers a refined, luxurious stay, with grand entrances and wraparound verandas looking out over the vast landscape and nearby places such as the villages of Motukeri and Nyakitono.

blocks.orig: You also get many comforts, including fireplaces, living rooms, and comfortable furnishings, and all this comes with a front-row seat to the 350,000-acre Singita Grumeti reserve.
blocks.html: Comfort is well catered for, with fireplaces, living rooms and soft furnishings, and all of it comes with a front-row seat to the 350,000-acre Singita Grumeti reserve.

blocks.orig: Not only this, but you get a chance to explore the depths of the Serengeti, bush walks, wellness treatments, and some tennis, for more ways to unwind, so where are you going to start?
blocks.html: And there is more: exploring deep into the Serengeti, bush walks, wellness treatments and a game of tennis are all further ways to relax. So where will you begin?

blocks.orig: Our final destination is a camp that is placed by the majestic Mara river and gives you a different type of safari experience as you can explore the 98,000 acres of the nature reserve. With a smaller visitor capacity, you also get a service that feels personal.
blocks.html: Our last stop is a camp beside the majestic Mara river, which offers a different kind of safari experience, as you can roam the 98,000 acres of the nature reserve. Because the camp takes fewer guests, the service feels personal.

blocks.orig: You can find excellent views whether you’re lounging on the netted beds or making tracks in the national park, and with a smaller area, you get to observe the animals you desire most.
blocks.html: The views are superb whether you are stretched out on the netted beds or tracking through the park, and because the area is compact, you get to watch the animals you most want to see.

blocks.orig: You can encounter hippos, crocodiles, big cats, giraffes, and wildebeests in a way that doesn’t put too much pressure on the environment and is excellent for those who want an experience that is out of the way.
blocks.html: Hippos, crocodiles, big cats, giraffes and wildebeest can all be seen here in a way that puts little pressure on the environment, which is ideal for anyone wanting an experience away from the crowds.

blocks.orig: As you’ve seen, the options are (almost) endless. However, before you settle on one stay, you should be aware that any tours, excursions, and activity centers might require you to book prior to your arrival to avoid any disappointments.
blocks.html: As you can see, the choice is (almost) endless. Before you settle on a stay, however, bear in mind that tours, excursions and activity centres may need to be booked before you arrive, to avoid disappointment.

blocks.orig: You also get to see these national parks from unique perspectives. Whether you want a panoramic view or a simple spot near a river, you can decide how close you want to be in the midst of the action.
blocks.html: Each of these places also shows you the national parks from a different perspective. Whether you prefer a panoramic outlook or a simple spot by a river, you decide how close to the action you want to be.
